cards.title: Learning focus
cards.body: I can explain tables and constant change using words, tables, graphs, or equations.

cards.title: Vocabulary and meaning
cards.body: Rate of change is how much an output changes for one unit of input. A starting value is the output when input is zero.

cards.title: Example
cards.body: A bike rental costs $4 plus $3 per hour. Write or explain a model for the relationship.
cards.answer: A reasonable model is y=3x+4 The starting value is 4; the rate is 3 per hour.

cards.title: You Try It
cards.body: A bike rental costs $4 plus $3 per hour. Predict an output and justify it using the model.

cards.title: Launch
cards.body: Discuss: A bike rental costs $4 plus $3 per hour. What quantities vary? How could a table help?
cards.answer: The starting value is 4; the rate is 3 per hour.

cards.title: Review & Preview
cards.body: A bike rental costs $4 plus $3 per hour. Show the mathematics and explain your reasoning.

cards.title: Example

cards.title: Learning focus
cards.body: I can explain function transformations using words, tables, graphs, or equations.

cards.title: Vocabulary and meaning
cards.body: Rate of change is how much an output changes for one unit of input. A starting value is the output when input is zero.

cards.title: Example
cards.body: The parent function is f(x)=x^2. Write or explain a model for the relationship.
cards.answer: A reasonable model is g(x)=x^2+3 Replacing f(x) with f(x)+3 moves the graph up 3 units.

cards.title: You Try It
cards.body: The parent function is f(x)=x^2. Predict an output and justify it using the model.

cards.title: Launch
cards.body: Discuss: The parent function is f(x)=x^2. What quantities vary? How could a table help?
cards.answer: Replacing f(x) with f(x)+3 moves the graph up 3 units.

cards.title: Review & Preview
cards.body: The parent function is f(x)=x^2. Show the mathematics and explain your reasoning.
